ownership.quote: Skyhook: PaaS-like experience with the power of Kubernetes, on your cloud. Winter 2023. Active.

stage.note: At least pre-seed: went through Y Combinator (Winter 2023), which invests in every company it takes; no later round found.

employees.source: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/skyhook (YC profile field "team_size":7; may be stale/founding-era figure, not re-verified for 2026)

note: Company was founded in 2023 by Nadav Erell (CTO, ex-Google) and Oded Regev (CEO, ex-Cherrypick Consulting), went through YC W23 as 'KoalaOps', and has since rebranded to 'Skyhook' (koalaops.com now 301-redirects to skyhook.io). The current website's About page lists different team bios (founders said to be from Google, eToro, Armis, OneZero) and blog posts through 2026 are bylined by an Eyal Dulberg (CTO) and Roy Libman (CPO) — names not matching the original YC founders, suggesting team/leadership changes since the YC launch, though Nadav Erell (nadaverell) still appears as an active author on the skyhook-io GitHub org as of 2026. No funding round, investor, or revenue data beyond YC participation was found; treat funding/revenue as unknown rather than assumed bootstrapped.
